page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin, heavily damaged by red stains and show-through. Running head at top with page number at top right; catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: ex Deo quæsisse, an latæ leges ad virtutem felicitatemque civitatis probè haberent, & responsum ei esse, leges rectè habere, & civitatem clarissimam futuram, quamdiu his institutis esset usura: atque hoc oraculum literis mandatum Spartam misisse, & repetito sacrificio amplexatum suos, quos secum habebat, ratumque, satis se sibi ac patriæ vixisse, spontaneâ morte vitam Delphis finivisse, ut hoc modo ad servanda in per[illegible, ~6 letters]petuum instituta sua civitatem obligaret. Quod ad eorum perennitaté haud parum valuisse, Plutarchus credi vult.[illegible, ~4 letters] Sed nihil tam sanctum, tam bene mu[illegible, ~4 letters]nitum, quod non paulatim tempus vi[illegible, ~4 letters]tiet ac violet: quod his accidisse Ly[illegible, ~4 letters]curgi legibus, quamvis optimis, & tal[illegible, ~4 letters]modo sanctitis, postea ostendemus. Nunc ad rem, à qua digressi breviter sumus. In formanda republ. & legibus scribendis huc præcipuè velut ad scopum collimavit Lycurgus, ut regnum moderatæ potestatis finibus circumscriberet, ut æqualitati, optimæ nutrici concordiæ, quæ robur tum omnis societatis tum maximè rerum publicarum[illegible, ~5 letters] est, locum in eo pararet, & populum universum assuetudine, à teneris ad parendum legibus & legitimis imperiis, ad juste parceque vivendum, ad commen

page.notes: The right margin carries several fragmentary notes that are almost entirely obscured by red staining and show-through; only a few letter fragments are faintly visible, so they are marked illegible at their approximate positions. The word "parceque" is as printed and may be a printing variant; it is not certain. The bottom right shows a faint mark beside the catchword, probably stain, and no gathering signature could be read. The top of the page carries the running head "REIP. LACONVM." and the page number 123.
